about: Every word of the Carnet app, per language: the iOS table (Localizable.xcstrings) as the app reads it, against the copy Android ships (files/strings, written out by scripts/sync-strings.sh). Android's own additions (files/android: the words Carnet iOS writes in English, unkeyed) are keys iOS does not have and are not compared; nor is Maurice's table, which Android loads underneath.
ios: CarnetApp/Localizable.xcstrings, compiled into <lang>.lproj/Localizable.strings, read from the runner's bundle
android: carnet/shared composeResources files/strings/<lang>.strings, parsed by ui Strings.parse
